name: John Doe
headline: Senior Product Manager · AI product, B2B SaaS, platform
resume_summary: John Doe is a product manager with 12+ years across healthcare software, logistics and applied AI. At Lumen Health Systems, John is a Senior Product Manager on Clinical Intelligence, owning AI-assisted note drafting and the clinician review queue, plus the evaluation framework for AI output across the product: golden sets, rubric scoring, model selection and release gates. John is leading Care Coordination 2.0, a redesign of scheduling and handoffs with three entry points (referral, inbox and patient timeline), and proposed a Referral Intake Hub that converts faxed and emailed referrals into structured records, backed by the discovery interviews behind it. Earlier, John built machine learning features for dispatch and route planning at Fieldstone Freight along with the internal API platform other teams used, shipped claims intake and adjuster tools at Cedar Mutual, and worked on benefits enrollment and employer admin tools at Pinewood Benefits. John tracks competing care-coordination platforms through customer calls and win/loss notes, and works hands-on in Mixpanel, BigQuery, Tableau, SQL and Python. John holds an MS in Information Systems from Westbrook University and a BS in Economics from Lakeland College.
fit_signals: Owns a product area end to end: strategy, discovery, roadmap and measurable outcomes
AI/ML product work focused on evaluation, quality gates, model selection and context
Platform or internal tooling where the users are other product and engineering teams
0-to-1 product building with real scope and executive visibility
B2B SaaS at a company with a real engineering culture and data stack
Fully remote in the US, or Boston-area hybrid at two to three days per week
Staff, principal, group or lead PM scope; director of product at a small or mid-size company
Healthcare, logistics or insurance software domains where prior context compounds
anti_signals: Posting uses AI vocabulary but the job is really backlog management and ticket writing
Product owner role with no strategy or discovery ownership
Five days a week onsite, or onsite-only outside Massachusetts
Associate or junior PM scope, or a PM role reporting into marketing as product marketing
Program, project or technical program management disguised as product
Staffing or recruiting firm reposting another company's job
